name: @internal/opencode-mcp
description: Stdio MCP server that lets enterprise Claude Code delegate work to an internal OpenCode instance (delegate, reply, status, cancel, end).

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/opencode-mcp.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run bundle
